make.name: Polestar
make.description: Swedish electric-car brand that grew out of a racing team founded in 1996, bought by Volvo in 2015 and relaunched as a standalone EV maker in 2017; it is majority-owned by Geely founder Li Shufu's companies and Geely Holding. In June 2026 it said it would stop selling new cars in the US after being denied authorisation under the Connected Vehicle Rule, and it is concentrating on Europe.

models.name: Polestar 2
models.description: Polestar's first electric car, a five-door fastback on Volvo's CMA platform built in Luqiao, China from March 2020. It switched to rear-wheel drive and bigger batteries for model year 2024. Production of the first generation ended in October 2026 after about 200,000 cars; stock is sold into 2027 and a second-generation Polestar 2 is due in 2027. It left the US after the 2025 model year.

generations.name: Original
generations.description: Launch version: front-drive single motors or a 300 kW dual-motor AWD, 69 or 78 kWh packs.

variants.name: Long Range Dual Motor Performance Pack

generations.name: Rear-drive update
generations.description: Model-year 2024 update: rear-wheel-drive single motors, 82 kWh Long Range pack, more powerful dual motor, and a closed 'SmartZone' front panel. Production ended in October 2026; remaining stock is still being sold.

variants.name: Long Range Dual Motor Performance Pack

generations.name: Second generation
generations.description: Redesigned Polestar 2 announced in February 2026 on a dedicated EV platform, built in China, due in early 2027.

models.name: Polestar 3
models.description: Mid-size electric SUV on the SPA2 platform shared with the Volvo EX90, revealed in October 2022 and built from 2024 in Chengdu and Ridgeville, South Carolina (Ridgeville only from March 2026). It moved to an 800-volt system with new motors and smaller packs in late 2025. New US sales stop after model year 2026 because Polestar was denied authorisation under the US Connected Vehicle Rule.

generations.name: Original (400 V)
generations.description: 400-volt system with a 111 kWh NMC pack and 250 kW DC charging.

variants.name: Long Range Dual Motor Performance Pack

generations.name: 800-volt update
generations.description: 800-volt system, new in-house rear motor, 92 kWh (Rear Motor) or 106 kWh packs, up to 350 kW DC charging and a faster Nvidia computer. Exterior essentially unchanged.

models.name: Polestar 4
models.description: Coupe-styled SUV with no rear window, on Geely's SEA platform, revealed in April 2023 and built in Ningbo, China and, from late 2025, at Renault Korea in Busan. A conventional SUV body with a rear window was added in September 2026 (Europe first). The US gets no new model years after 2026.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: SEA-platform coupe SUV (from late 2023) and, from September 2026, an SUV body with a rear window; ~100 kWh pack.

models.name: Polestar 5
models.description: Four-door electric grand tourer developed from the 2020 Precept concept, shown at the 2025 Munich show and built in China with an 800-volt, 112 kWh SK On pack. It went on sale in Europe in 2026; it is not offered in the US or China.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Bonded-aluminium four-door GT with dual motors and 800-volt charging.

models.name: Polestar 7
models.description: Compact premium electric SUV announced in February 2026 for a 2028 launch, to be built in Europe (Kosice, Slovakia) in a factory shared with Volvo. It takes priority over the delayed Polestar 6 roadster.

legacy_notes.note: Polestar 2 'Dual Motor Performance' = MY2024-25 Long Range Dual Motor with Performance Pack (EPA 247/254 mi). Price $64,800 not re-sourced. Its image (polestar_2_dual_m_perf.png) shows the BST edition 230 special edition, not a regular Performance Pack car; not reused.

Duplicate make_model_slug 'polestar-two' merged into 'polestar-2'. Row says FWD but its 299 hp / 320 mi are the MY2024 rear-wheel-drive Long Range Single Motor. Image polestar_2_single_m.png shows a black BST edition 270 (a dual-motor, pre-facelift special edition): wrong car, not reused. US price $47,800 not re-sourced; single motor left the US after MY2024.
Duplicate slug 'polestar-two' merged. 421 hp / 276 mi = MY2024 Long Range Dual Motor. Image polestar_2_dual_m.png (white, SmartZone front) verified as the 2024 facelift and reused.

Polestar 3 Performance: vehicle_class 'Compact luxury Sedan' is wrong (mid-size SUV). $89,900 is the pre-March-2024 price; MY2025 Performance (with Pilot pack) is $79,400. EPA MY2025 279 mi (row says 270). New US model years end after MY2026.

Polestar 4 row is stale: 'Not yet released' and a $60,000 estimate. It has been on sale since 2024 (Europe) and in the US for MY2025-26 (Dual Motor $62,900, EPA 272/280 mi, 544 hp). Its 'Dual Motor Performance' label is the Dual Motor (the Performance Pack adds wheels/brakes, not power). Image (side view, coupe) verified and reused.
Polestar 3 Long Range Dual Motor: $83,900 is the old launch price (MY2025 $73,400); EPA MY2025 310-315 mi (row 300). vehicle_class 'Sedan' wrong.

gaps: WebSearch budget for the session ran out mid-research; later facts come from Wikipedia, EPA data and articles already fetched.

Polestar 6 roadster (announced for 2026, now delayed with timing 'open', after 2028 at the earliest) is not included because no launch year can be sourced for a generation slug; the director may want to add it as 'upcoming'.

Polestar 4 Wagon/SUV: TFLcar (Feb 2026) said a Polestar 4 wagon would reach the US in Q4 2026, but the June 2026 US ban overtook that; the SUV body is modelled as variants of the one Polestar 4 generation.

One buyer's guide claimed US MY2026 Polestar 3 cars still use the 400 V/111 kWh setup; EPA MY2026 motor ratings (245 kW single motor) and the lower ranges match the 800 V car, so US 2026 offerings are on the 800 V refresh. Unconfirmed by Polestar US.
Polestar 2 US prices, Polestar 2 MY2021-23 Performance Pack power, 0-60 times for older Polestar 2 versions, and Polestar 4 coupe battery capacity (Wikipedia 102 kWh vs 100 kWh elsewhere) left null.
Polestar 3/4 MY2026 US prices not sourced; Polestar 5 Performance WLTP and price not sourced; Polestar 5 price sources disagree (EUR 118,600-119,900); Wikipedia/Reuters EUR 119,900 used.
Polestar 2 WLTP figures come from German Wikipedia whose tables flatten model years; treat as approximate.
Polestar 1 (2019-2022) is a plug-in hybrid and is intentionally excluded.
